title: TenantContext
description: Immutable identity of the tenant on whose behalf an operation runs. Once created it MUST NOT change (see core/spec.md, ADR-004). Carried across every tenant-aware operation.

tenantId.description: Stable, unique identifier of the tenant. Non-empty. The isolation boundary key.

tenantName.description: Human-readable tenant name. Informational only; never used as an isolation key.

traceId.description: W3C Trace Context trace-id (32 lowercase hex chars) correlating this context across services.

metadata.description: Opaque string->string tenant attributes (region, tier, regulator, etc.). Not trusted for isolation decisions.
